metadata.title: Weekly Crypto Pulse: ETF Flows Steady, Altcoins Pause
metadata.summary: Bitcoin held above key support as ETF inflows remained positive, while majors rotated and high-beta altcoins cooled after a two-week rally.

movers.name: Bitcoin
movers.catalyst: Consistent spot ETF net inflows and resilient bid near support.

movers.name: Solana
movers.catalyst: Profit-taking after strong momentum run and softer on-chain activity.

movers.name: Chainlink
movers.catalyst: New enterprise integration announcements improved sentiment.

sections.heading: Market Overview
sections.body: Price action was constructive but selective, with liquidity concentrated in BTC and large-cap pairs.
highlights: BTC closed the week above its 20-day moving average.
Funding rates normalized after mid-week leverage reset.

sections.heading: Positioning & Flows
sections.body: Institutional flows remained constructive, while retail participation flattened compared with the prior week.
highlights: US spot BTC ETFs logged a fifth consecutive week of net inflows.
Perpetual open interest rose modestly but stayed below January highs.

thesis: Major-asset demand remains the primary support while broad altcoin participation fades.
ETF-related flows are still cushioning pullbacks, but upside follow-through is slowing.
Positioning is shifting from high-beta momentum into higher-liquidity names.
riskChecklist: Watch for a break below prior weekly support in BTC before adding directional risk.
Monitor ETF net-flow momentum for a second consecutive down week.
Track funding and open interest for signs of leverage re-expansion.
Confirm stablecoin supply growth continues to support spot liquidity.
Respect macro event windows that can override crypto-native flow signals.

watchlistLevels.context: Holding support keeps the range constructive; reclaiming resistance reopens trend continuation.
Sustained closes above pivot improve odds of renewed ETH-led breadth.
A fresh low would confirm ongoing altcoin-relative weakness.
